hook.name: PeepsV4TaxHook
hook.description: A tax-on-swap hook for Peeps V4 token launches that skims configurable buy/sell taxes via BeforeSwapDelta, then distributes collected amounts across funds, burn, dividend, and liquidity sinks in afterSwap. Enforces an optional anti-farmer window blocking third-party LP additions, and gates all swaps via a registry-controlled clearing window.
